name: Buddha Rice  Vietnamese For Zwt 9
instructions: Heat oil in a lrg saucepan
Add ginger & stir-fry for 1 min until fragrant
Add rice & cook for 2 min , stirring to coat well
Add bay leaf , coconut milk , water & soy sauce
Bring to a boil & cook for about 5 min
Reduce heat to very low , cover & continue to cook for a further 20 minutes
Remove from the heat & leave to rest for about 10 min
Uncover , add salt as desired , fluff the rice up w / a fork & serve hot
